description.zh: 指定要操作的app编号，一个带有格式的 JSON 数组，最多支持 100 个 AppId，用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of the apps to operate on. A formatted JSON array that supports up to 100 AppIds, separated by commas (,).

description.zh: 要查询的App列表，空值则查询所有App信息
description.en: List of apps to query. If empty, all app information is queried.

description.zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识。
description.en: A string generated by the server that serves as an identifier for the client request.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~354276~~)查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表。
description.en: Region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) to query the list of regions supported by EBS Data Insights.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

查询用户定义的App所包含的云盘和快照的标签键值，可通过filterTagKey缩小查询范围。
descriptions.en:
## API Description

Query the tag key-value pairs of cloud disks and snapshots contained in user-defined apps. You can use filterTagKey to narrow the query scope.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs describe-apps --app-names default --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --owner 1485558146415628 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --app-ids app-25603551 --region cn-hangzhou
